ITEM 1 | Dark green leafy greens, flat broad leaves with visible veins, matte with slight moisture, covering most of the upper and central plate; leaves roughly 5-8 cm long, lying in a loose heap | 90
ITEM 2 | Thin orange shredded strips, bright orange with slightly glossy surface, scattered throughout the leaves in pieces about 3-5 cm long and under 0.5 cm thick | 15
ITEM 3 | Dark green thin stalks, long and slender, about 0.3 cm thick and 5-8 cm long, some with a glossy sheen, arranged in a loose pile at the lower edge of the leaves | 35
ITEM 4 | Two whole small red tomatoes, glossy smooth skin, about 2-2.5 cm diameter, one near the upper right edge and one at the lower center of the leaves | 25
ITEM 5 | Pale green to white thin slivers, slightly translucent, a few small pieces tucked among the leaves near the center | 5
